name: study-group-finder
comment: Turborepo task wrapper for the Flutter app. `type: module` is load-bearing for env.ts: without it tsx compiles the manifest as CommonJS, whose require() of the ESM @devdogsuga/env creates a SECOND registry instance — declare() then registers into a copy nobody reads, and the app's variables silently vanish from the generated .env.example (vitest ESM-ifies everything, so the completeness test cannot see the difference). The real toolchain is Flutter/Dart; these scripts shell out to it via the root `with-env` helper so the Flutter build reads the shared root .env. They use `with-env -c` because $API_URL and friends must expand from the loaded .env rather than the ambient environment. Requires the Flutter SDK on PATH.
